run_wiki_ict_preprocessing: run the CLI tool to preprocess Wikipedia passages into ICT training and dev JSONL files
process_passage_for_ict: process a Wikipedia passage by splitting sentences and generating in-context learning query-passage pairs
generate_ict_data: generate in-context learning data by sampling random sentences as queries from a passage
prep_wiki_passages: parse a TSV file of Wikipedia passages and group them by title into a document dictionary
get_lines_from_doc_dict: iterate over a document dictionary and yield sentence-split passages with computed query counts
